contract_accepts_packed_float_input.meaning: the smart contract accepts user-supplied packedFloat input for Float128 calculation

input_passes_sanity_check.meaning: the user-supplied packedFloat is treated as good input by the contract's packedFloat threshold comparison

input_mantissa_digits.meaning: number of digits in the L_MANTISSA of the user-supplied packedFloat (report states 72)

calculation_result_consistent_with_encod.meaning: the Float128 calculation result is consistent with the value encoded by the input packedFloat rather than vastly different from wrong exponent adjustment
calculation_result_consistent_with_encod.checkpoint: after Float128 library decodes and calculates on the malformed packedFloat

result_outside_intended_usage_occurs.meaning: the calculation result is vastly different and falls outside the smart contract's intended usage
result_outside_intended_usage_occurs.checkpoint: after Float128 library decodes and calculates on the malformed packedFloat

assumptions: The attacker is permissionless; the report does not state an authorization requirement for submitting packedFloat input.
The sanity check is a packedFloat threshold comparison whose numeric threshold and direction are not specified; only its pass/fail outcome is modeled.
The malformed input is described as a potential attack vector, so the impact is formalized as a conditional possibility, not an observed transaction.

unresolved.description: The 'certain packedFloat' threshold value and comparison direction used by the sanity check are not numerically specified; only the pass/fail outcome is modeled.
The magnitude of the 'vastly different' calculation result is not quantified; the impact is represented as a qualitative Boolean outcome.

limitations: The plan formalizes only the target impact result_outside_intended_usage; other impacts (decode_same_mantissa_exponent, calculation_vastly_different_result, malformed_input_passes_sanity_check) are not covered by this claim.
The 72-digit mantissa is encoded as a dimensionless digit count; the report does not give a bit-length conversion for it.
The potential modality of the impact is preserved by treating the effect as a conditional possibility rather than an inevitable outcome.
